Send a message to a customer

Written by Dana Reyes
Updated over a week ago

Use the Messages API to send a message into an open conversation. The full list of fields is in the Messages API reference.

Request

POST /v1/messages
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

Body

json
{
  "conversation": "c_1042",
  "text": "Fish & chips are ready",
  "notify": true
}

The same call from a shell:

curl -X POST https://api.acme.test/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d @message.json

Parameters

FieldTypeNotes
conversationstringThe id of an open conversation
textstringThe message body, up to 4000 characters
notifybooleanSend the customer a notification
